$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the MCP Servers settings: whether agent chats cmux starts get the person's saved MCP servers (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/agent_tools.rs saved_servers_off, docs/chief-mcp-hub.md 2h). The daemon reads the key from the settings file when it creates a chat; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: mcpServers
lists.note: Settings > AI > MCP Servers, under the list of saved servers. Applies to chats created after the change.

rows.name: mcpServersEnabled
rows.note: On (the default): a new agent chat gets the mcp_servers tool (optchat-chief integrations serve), which lists and uses the saved servers the person's scope gives that chat. Off: acpmux leaves it out; Chiefs keep their own mcp tool.

help.text: New chats can use the servers listed above.
